QuestInfo.name: [Lethe] Unto the Breach
QuestInfo.0:
Haezel persuades you to reclaim your vassals from Maple World.

Speak to #p3007111# to prepare for your journey.
QuestInfo.1: Speak to #p3007111# again to learn how to return to the mansion.
QuestInfo.2: Haezel woke you, saying that during your long rest your vassals had escaped to Maple World. At her behest, you took it upon yourself to retrieve them.
